en.title: Aardman Unveils New Pokémon Series & Timmy Adventure at Annecy
en.summary: The legendary stop-motion studio Aardman has offered a tantalizing glimpse into its future, announcing exciting new projects that span beloved franchises and original adventures. Fans have much to look forward to as the animation powerhouse continues to innovate.
en.body:
The hallowed halls of the Annecy Animation Film Festival recently played host to a significant announcement from the masters of claymation themselves: **Aardman**. With over five decades of crafting beloved characters and stories, the studio took the stage to unveil a slate of new projects that promise to delight both long-time fans and newcomers alike. The legendary trio of co-founders, **Peter Lord**, **David Sproxton**, and fellow director **Nick Park**, were present to share the exciting news, underscoring the studio's enduring legacy and its vibrant vision for the future.

Among the most buzzed-about reveals is a brand-new **Pokémon** series titled **'Pokémon Tales'**. While details are still emerging, the prospect of Aardman's signature stop-motion magic being applied to the world of Pokémon has sent ripples of excitement through the fandom. Alongside this major franchise venture, Aardman also teased an original series called **'Let's Go Timmy!'**, which appears to be set in the charming Mossy Bottom world, a familiar and cherished locale for fans of their work. The festival also provided a look at **'The Almost (Untold) Story of Danger Delilah'**, an adaptation of **Oliver Jeffers'** book, further showcasing Aardman's commitment to diverse storytelling.

## Aardman's Vision for Animation

The studio's presence at Annecy was more than just a showcase of new ventures; it was a celebration of the art form itself. Aardman used the platform to not only look forward but also to reflect on its rich history, paying homage to the craft of clay animation and the dedicated individuals who bring it to life. The Aardman Academy was also highlighted, signaling the studio's dedication to nurturing the next generation of animators and storytellers. This dual focus on preserving tradition while embracing innovation is a hallmark of Aardman's approach, ensuring their unique brand of storytelling continues to captivate audiences worldwide.

> "With more than 50 years of clay animation, Aardman unveiled a glimpse of a bright future this year at the Annecy Animation Film Festival." — Variety TV

## What This Means for Fans

For fans who grew up with **Wallace & Gromit** or have recently been captivated by **Shaun the Sheep**, these announcements represent a significant expansion of the Aardman universe. The integration into the **Pokémon** franchise, in particular, is a bold move that bridges two massive global fandoms. The promise of new stories set in the Mossy Bottom universe offers a comforting return to familiar charm, while **'The Almost (Untold) Story of Danger Delilah'** hints at fresh, character-driven narratives. The stakes are high for these new projects to capture the same heart and humor that have defined Aardman's success for half a century, but the studio's track record instills a strong sense of confidence.

## What's Next

While specific release dates for **'Pokémon Tales'**, **'Let's Go Timmy!'**, and **'The Almost (Untold) Story of Danger Delilah'** have not yet been announced, the unveiling at Annecy in June 2026 suggests that production is well underway. Fans should keep a close eye on Aardman's official channels for further updates and potential sneak peeks as these exciting new series approach their debut.
